rules.notes: PLACEHOLDER — billed per demat account by AmcChargeService's cycle, never by a trade. This card leaves assetType, segment, exchange and planCode unset on purpose: the cycle context carries no scrip, quantity or asset type, so a card declaring any of those dimensions is disqualified by the resolver and the cycle bills nothing.
